question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's sustained control over the Chinese Communist Party, military, and state apparatus underpins the 96% trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Ongoing rectification campaigns and personnel changes have reinforced central authority without visible challenges to his position, while his active role in diplomacy, policy planning for the 15th Five-Year Plan, and preparations for the next Party Congress signal continuity. No designated successor has emerged, and institutional structures favor extended tenure following the 2018 removal of term limits. Low-probability shifts could still arise from acute health developments or an unforeseen elite fracture ahead of the 2027 congress.
